history.new: Proven for law 501, whose spectrum is exactly the n = 0, 1 (mod 4) (CLM-C05-22). Evidence for the other 11: none has a model of order 2, 6 or 10 (certified, CLM-C05-17), and the quasigroup laws 1076, 1110, 1279, 1286, 1313 none of order 10 (order 14 undecided). Spectra are closed under products, and a product has order 2 (mod 4) only if a factor has; the linear models of EXP-C05-07 have prime-power orders, odd or divisible by 4. The general form for all laws x = y*T is false (CLM-C05-18, law 474), so a proof must use more than the shape of the law. Twelve laws and two orders each are thin evidence; the statement is recorded to be tested, not as a finding.

Evidence for the other 11: none has a model of order 2, 6 or 10 (certified, CLM-C05-17); for the quasigroup laws 1076, 1110, 1279, 1286 and 1313 every order up to 13 is decided (CLM-C05-16), so 14 is their first open order = 2 (mod 4). A counterexample cannot come from group endomorphisms: in a group of order = 2 (mod 4) the elements of odd order form a subgroup of index 2 preserved by every endomorphism, so such a model would have a quotient of order 2, a model of order 2 (reviews/skeptic_batch1.2.md, section 4). statement: The laws 467, 501, 670, 677, 704, 907, 1076, 1083, 1110, 1279, 1286 and 1313 have no finite model of any order n = 2 (mod 4).
title: H-C05-J': none of the 12 open ETP laws x = y*T without a model of order 2 has a model of order n = 2 (mod 4)
